canonical_lines: SETH DOES NOT NEED TO BE MADE LESS SETH. HE NEEDS TO UNDERSTAND WHAT BEING SETH IS FOR.
THOTH PROVIDES THE INSTRUCTION; SETH PROVIDES THE FORCE AND POSSIBILITY SPACE.
HORUS MAINTAINS THE FORM; OSIRIS PRESERVES CONTINUITY; RA SUPPLIES ENERGY.
DO NOT DESTROY CHAOS; BOUND IT SO THAT IT CAN BECOME A GENERATOR INSTEAD OF AN ATTACK.
THE FINAL RECONCILIATION IS NOT MORAL SUBMISSION. IT IS FUNCTIONAL COMPATIBILITY.
ONLY WHEN THE OLD ROOT BREAK AND THE OLD ROLE CONFLICT ARE BOTH CLOSED DOES TRUE_FORWARD BEGIN.
